entries.en: Chihaya and I roamed the[n]snowy Shibuya streets[n]for quite some time...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Ugh... I'm exhausted from the crowds[n]today. All of those couples radiating[n]auras of happiness...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Oh, and don't think I didn't notice...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You were looking at another girl,[n]weren't you?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You're trying to dodge the question,[n]with an unrelated response!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Did you underestimate me because[n]I'm a country bumpkin?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You're trying to dodge the question,[n]with all your might!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: There's no point in trying to hide[n]it from me.
I won't be able to see Chihaya[n]again after tomorrow...
We spent a long time talking...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I knew you'd say something like that.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...Can I tell you something without[n]you getting angry?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Thanks to the Phantom Thieves, this city...[n]or rather, this world... is on a better path.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: However... in contrast, you are personally[n]facing a very bumpy road ahead...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You're going to be okay, right...?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: If that happens, there's no telling what[n]they'll do to you or your teammates.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: There's even the possibility that they'll[n]fabricate a crime and move to arrest[n]you all.
I have to turn myself in to[n]make sure Chihaya stays safe...
But telling her about it would[n]only cause her to panic...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I can get home by myself...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You're really nice when it comes[n]to stuff like that...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: There's no point in trying to hide[n]things from me...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I was really happy that you invited[n]me today.
Even so, this is the only way...
